newsitem.title: UK: Capital Radio names unit head in reshuffle.
newsitem.headline: Capital Radio names unit head in reshuffle.

text.p: Britain's Capital Radio Plc said on Tuesday it named Russell Scott as chief executive of its My Kinda Town restaurant unit as part of a management reshuffle within the company.
Scott was set to join Capital from fish and chip chain Harry Ramsden's Plc, where he was UK chief executive and group operations director, the firm said.
"His appointment provides additional strength to Capital Radio as it develops its widened interests as a music entertainment group through themed restaurants," the firm said in a statement.
Capital also said it named Richard Eyre, previously managing director, as chief executive and appointed David Mansfield, previously group commercial director, as group managing director.
Capital unveiled plans last week to buy Richard Branson's Virgin Radio in a 65 million stg deal. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
